kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: U.S. debt tops $40 trillion. And, new census report Trump is touting raises concerns
wire.summary: The U.S. debt has surpassed $40 trillion. And, a new census report on noncitizen voting that President Trump is touting has ties to a think tank aligned with him, raising concerns among experts.

wire.title: North Korea fires a suspected missile toward the sea, Japan says
wire.summary: The suspected launch on Thursday comes a day after North Korea shrugged off a U.S. decision to scale back military drills with South Korea in an apparent bid to resume diplomacy.

wire.title: The bond market is signaling trouble ahead. This is why you should pay attention
wire.summary: Many people don't pay attention to bond markets, but they should — especially now. This is why they matter and why the drop in bond prices is signaling investor concerns about the U.S. economy.

wire.title: Privacy advocates call on Maryland to investigate data brokers
wire.summary: Maryland has one of the strictest data privacy laws in the country. But privacy advocates allege data brokers are violating the law by selling data to police and federal immigration agencies.

wire.title: Which country makes the best jollof rice? D.C. foodies put it to a blind test
wire.summary: One of the most famous dishes across West Africa is jollof rice — fragrant rice cooked down with spices, tomatoes and meat. But which version is best? A traveling festival aims to find out.

wire.title: Here's how the system to report problems in ICE detention has failed immigrants
wire.summary: Critics say it is the reason why more detainees are risking their lives to protest inhumane conditions and legal rights violations, in the form of widespread hunger strikes.

wire.title: They grew up with disability rights. Now, they're fighting to keep them
wire.summary: Siblings Cody and Kaleigh Brendle have grown up with the right to community integration. Now, they worry those protections for people with disabilities like them are being eroded.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Gulf countries react to protracted Iran war, U.S. debt tops $40 trillion, U.S. oil companies sign first deals with Venezuela.

wire.title: Tech billionaires push back against proposed wealth tax in California
wire.summary: Tech billionaires in California are fighting a proposed one-time wealth tax. A Google co-founder is leading the charge against the tax, which would generate revenue for health-care services.

wire.title: Chinese court sentences founder of property developer Evergrande to life in prison
wire.summary: Chinese property developer Hui Ka Yan has been sentenced to life in prison. The decision marks a milestone in Evergrande's saga after it collapsed with more than $300 billion in liabilities.

wire.title: At least 15 killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages
wire.summary: Blocks of flats and warehouses were targeted in the "massive attack" on Thursday, Ukrainian officials say.

wire.title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
wire.summary: Hui's sentencing marks a key moment in the fallout from Evergrande's collapse, which shook China's property sector.

wire.title: Trump vows tougher economic measures on Iran and supporting countries
wire.summary: It comes after a 60-day ceasefire expired on Monday, with no sign of a diplomatic or military off-ramp to the conflict.

wire.title: Belgian car salesman becomes prince after royal parentage confirmed
wire.summary: Clément Vandenkerckhove was quietly brought into Prince Laurent's family at a town hall ceremony.

wire.title: Mushroom killer must stay in jail forever for 'truly dreadful' crime, appeal court told
wire.summary: Prosecutors say Erin Patterson's sentence was "manifestly inadequate" as it allows for the possibility of parole.

wire.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israel decides not to open criminal investigation into killing of aid worker in Gaza
wire.summary: Australia's foreign minister summoned the Israeli ambassador over "insulting" Zomi Frankcom decision.
